mutations.name: a newer ask about the same PR no longer replaces the older row
mutations.find: best === undefined || newer(item, best) ? item : best
kills: one row per PR keeps only the newest ask about a PR blocking, so a later deposit replaces the gate it restates

mutations.name: an sh-sent-back gate blocks with no blocking owner op
kills: an sh-sent-back gate is the implementer's to clear unless an owner op on its PR asks the owner to act
an sh-sent-back gate stays the implementer's beside an owner op that does not block, such as a close-pr cleanup
an sh-sent-back gate does not take its PR's one blocking row with it when it is the newest ask

mutations.name: a chat approval keeps blocking for four days, not one
kills: an agent-chat approval stops blocking a day after it was asked, since its prompt has timed out or been relayed

mutations.name: no blocking item is ever marked aged
kills: a blocking item past four days stays blocking, marked aged and listed after the fresh blockers
a blocking item past four days keeps a coordinator's merge-at-head ask on a live PR visible as aged blocking, over the older gate it restates

mutations.name: a Planning item about a PR demotes its live blocker
kills: one row per PR never lets a newer ask that does not block itself demote a live gate on the same PR
a deposit or chat ask in the inbox blocks on a merge op only at the live run's head, and never for a cleanup op
